name: Fortis Healthcare Limited
summary: Fortis Healthcare Limited operates as a healthcare delivery service provider in India. The company services in the areas of cardiac science, nephrology, diabetology/endocrinology, foetal medicine, infectious diseases, mental health and behavioral science, oncology, orthopedics, physiotherapy and rehabilitation, rheumatology, urology, nuclear medicine, critical care, emergency and trauma, general surgery, internal medicine, neurointerventional radiology, obstetrics and gynaecology, pediatrics, pediatrics, vascular surgery, and support facilities.
